stem.en: Put the tape's story in order, from gene to protein.

text.en: RNA polymerase grips a promoter and copies one strand of a gene into an mRNA.
In the nucleus, the copy is spliced, introns out and exons joined exactly, capped and tailed.
The message is escorted out through a nuclear pore to the workshop floor.
Charging enzymes attach each amino acid to the tRNA whose anticodon matches its codon.
A ribosome checks each tRNA's anticodon against the codon, joins the beads by RNA, and shifts, from AUG to a stop.
The finished chain folds by its sequence, and transcription factors and chromatin set how often the whole thing runs.
